scenes.title: Behind the ad
scenes.intro: Say you opened the link in the ad. Make the right call at every step on the site.

steps.label: Presenter reveals the secret on air: 3000 a month
steps.say: The video talks just like the presenter.

actions.label: Watch the video and sign up
actions.feedback: The video was made with AI; the presenter never said this. The page leads to a scam platform.

actions.label: Close the tab
actions.feedback: Right. A big profit promise and a fake domain are enough.

actions.label: Invest 250 manat
actions.feedback: Your card details went to scammers and the money will not return. Call your bank now and block the card.

actions.label: Close the tab
actions.feedback: Right. Card details never go to a platform you do not know.

steps.label: Presenter: the ad using my name is fake
steps.say: This is the news site's real address.

actions.label: Read the article
actions.feedback: Right. Checking a doubtful story on the official source is the most reliable way.

actions.label: Share with family
actions.feedback: Good idea. Sharing the official denial protects others too.
